tool.name: browser-use
tool.summary: An open-source AI browser agent: the model writes Python against raw Chrome DevTools Protocol in a persistent REPL and drives a real browser.

features.title: One REPL, raw CDP
features.what: The model writes Python against raw Chrome DevTools Protocol in one persistent REPL session.
features.evidence_quote: The agent writes Python against raw CDP in a persistent REPL

features.title: More stars than the classics
features.what: On GitHub the repository now counts more stars than Playwright or Puppeteer.

features.title: Drives your own Chrome
features.what: It can drive the Chrome you already have open, with your logins still in it.
features.evidence_quote: drives the Chrome you have open, with your logins

features.title: Runs on any LLM
features.what: It runs on any LLM, on your own machine or on Browser Use Cloud.
features.evidence_quote: Runs on any LLM, locally or on Browser Use Cloud

features.title: A guard, not a sandbox
features.what: Model-written Python is not sandboxed, so restrict the domains and pin the exact version.
features.evidence_quote: It is a guard for an aligned model, not a sandbox
